Officer's narrative
At approximately the time noted in the report header, Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Baytown,
Texas, when the front of Driver 2's vehicle strcuk the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the
front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and stated that the
force of the collision threw them forward against the restraint. The injury described fits the type and force of this
impact.
Damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with a side impact at this angle. Photographs taken at the scene
confirm the general location of the damage. A few older scratches on the lower rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle
may predate this collision; the examining officer noted them but could not link them to this event.
No independent witnesses were located. Responding officers and two people at the scene confirmed that Driver 1
and Passenger were inside the vehicle when it came to rest. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle, according to documents presented at the scene.
